name: @mashbean/pocket-maple
description: Pocket Maple (口袋公聽): written testimony on a bill or hearing item with a public archive, on a single Cloudflare Worker with Durable Objects — Taiwan bill data pulled from the token-free ly.govapi.tw API; stance + testimony per person, public archive, tttc.csv; no accounts, no AI, one-click deploy

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run deploy:dry && npm run deploy:dry:production

ASSETS.description: Static create, testify, archive and host pages.

HEARING.description: One SQLite Durable Object per hearing item: the agenda snapshot and every testimony.

COORDINATOR.description: Durable Object holding the deployment-wide creation rate limit.
